title: Signs You Could Benefit from a Tummy Tuck in Baton Rouge
metaDescription: If you cannot get a flat stomach no matter how much you exercise or how many diets you try, a tummy tuck in Baton Rouge, or abdominoplasty, from Hanemann...
html:
If you cannot get a flat stomach no matter how much you exercise or how many diets you try, a tummy tuck in Baton Rouge, or abdominoplasty, from Hanemann Plastic Surgery could be the answer. Getting a flat stomach isn‘t as easy as some people think, it is often hard for the body to bounce back after drastic body changes such as weight loss or having a baby.
An abdominoplasty repairs drooping skin by removing and re-positioning it to create a sleeker look. You may think only women seek this treatment, but men seek it too. The following signs could be an indication you could benefit from a tummy tuck.
You Have Excessive Loose Skin That Won’t Go Away
Sagging skin has several causes including natural aging, obesity, and pregnancy. Drooping skin that isn’t altered by diet and exercise is one sign you need a tummy tuck. This occurs because pregnancy and being overweight stretches the skin and may permanently damage muscles. Even when you have the baby or lose weight, the damaged muscles can’t be repaired through diet and exercise.
There should also be enough skin for the doctor to reconstruct it properly or the skin will stretch. Liposuction addresses skin sag at the waist and lower stomach, but it won’t fix the muscles that cause bulging. Liposuction is ideal for clients without excessive stomach sagging.
You Have a Stomach Crease or a Belly That Overhangs
A stomach crease could be resolved with a tummy tuck in Baton Rouge. A stomach crease is caused by excess skin on either side of the fold. The crease seems to only appear when you sit, but not stand. This occurs because the abdomen stretches in standing position.
A tummy tuck in Baton Rouge can also resolve an overhanging belly, sometimes called muffin top. A belly hang usually comes down over your pants or underwear. It is commonly a popular reason people seek the procedure.
You Are Done Having Kids or Losing Weight
It is advised to delay a tummy tuck in Baton Rouge until you do not plan to have any more children, or it may cause the reconstructed areas to separate. However, if you get pregnant unexpectedly, a previous tummy tuck will not affect your pregnancy. An ideal candidate is within 15 to 30 pounds of their target weight for their height, age, and body size. Otherwise, excessive weight loss leaves too much loose skin, and it will not produce the desired results.
A tummy tuck in Baton Rouge at Hanemann Plastic Surgery can reshape your midsection and restore your body confidence. Contact us today to schedule your consultation and get started!
